about: A Markdown parser for Python, ported from the JavaScript markdown-it.

prs.title: Code in an image description now stays in its alt text
prs.broken: When an image description in Markdown contained a bit of code, that word vanished from the alt text in the finished HTML.
prs.changed: Code text now goes into the alt text along with the words around it, as in the original JavaScript parser.
prs.matters: People using screen readers get the full description of the image.
